op0r reset with SETUP_SQL, no seed
verify_context against the export (not a pin)

batch end marker; whole-batch session audit

ds_char created, filled with 27 binding rows, then dropped
no_other_effects: no other database or schema touched
no file written outside the evidence directory

session_accounting.parent_session_records: connection received; exactly one connection authenticated (identity = admin user, method = authentication_method); exactly one connection authorized (user, database, tag); the approved statements; exactly one disconnection matching the connection; session lines consecutive from 1. Any other record fails
session_accounting.log_reader: one session for the whole batch, identified by the rows that wrote each operation's markers. Inside an operation window it may only issue the exact end-of-session poll for that operation's tag, after the session's last statement, on consecutive session lines between the two markers; its statements are never prepared
session_accounting.batch_audit: the established reader's rows must run on consecutive session lines between the batch markers; a second session naming itself the log reader fails the audit
session_accounting.observed_basis: PostgreSQL 16.15 records from the version 1 run; see tests/research_tracks/fixtures

client_connection_policy.scope: Gate A1-owned connections only: the log reader and every tagged parent session, both opened by RealEffects in research_tools/gate_a1_characterize.py. Not Gate 2A, Gate A2, Phase 9B or any application or arm connection
client_connection_policy.enforced: set at both connection sites, checked on each connection before use, and any statement logged under a prepared-statement name fails reconciliation and the batch audit
client_connection_policy.limitation: the evidence characterizes psycopg with automatic preparation disabled; it establishes nothing about default auto-prepared sessions, which the version 2 run observed

parameter_log_model.strings: sent as text; logged as given, single quotes doubled
parameter_log_model.integers_booleans_floats: sent in binary by psycopg 3 (Int2/Int4/Int8, Bool, Float binary dumpers); logged with the type's text output
parameter_log_model.float8: shortest exact decimal (extra_float_digits=1, pinned in session_options): NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, '-0' for negative zero (observed), Python repr for non-integral finite values below 1e15 or in exponent form. Positive zero, integral values and 1e15 <= |x| < 1e16 have no established form and are refused before any SQL runs
parameter_log_model.observed_basis: the third real run's op7b statements, tests/research_tracks/fixtures/gate_a1_v3_observed.csv
